# Project profile and request

- Output language: English.
- Format: Markdown only.
- Story form: `As a ... I want ... so that ...`.
- Acceptance-criteria IDs: `AC-01`, `AC-02`, and so on.
- Forbidden: YAML frontmatter, String Keys, template prose, Confluence HTML,
  and technical design sections.
- Request: a Task Supervisor can change the priority of an active task.
